welcome_subtitle: Give your AI coding agent a personality
known_mbti_prompt: Do you already know your MBTI type?
known_mbti_quiz: No, take me through the quiz
invalid_mbti: Invalid MBTI type. Please enter a valid 4-letter type (e.g. INTJ, ENFP).
quiz_intro: A quick quiz to find your perfect agent personality.
your_mbti_result: Based on your answers, your personality type is: {type}
no_tools_selected: No tools selected. Please select at least one.
done_message: Your AI agent is now a {type} ({name}).

questions.text: Friday afternoon — Production just had three bugs explode, and you finally fixed them by evening. How do you close out the day?
choices: Close all Slack notifications, headphones on, tinker on a side project or read tech articles alone
Find a teammate for a quick retro chat, or grab a drink to decompress together

questions.text: Your PM drops a new feature request with three lines of context. What's your first move?
choices: Start thinking about system architecture, how it fits the roadmap, and future scalability
Fire off a list of clarifying questions: edge cases, acceptance criteria, what the DB schema needs

questions.text: A junior engineer submits a PR that's fundamentally wrong — not style issues, but the architectural approach is off. You...
choices: Leave precise review comments: "This will cause X problem. The correct approach is Y."
Schedule a 15-min pairing session, understand their thinking first, then work toward a better solution together

questions.text: Sprint Planning is tomorrow. Tonight you...
choices: Pre-read all tickets, estimate complexity, prep notes — walk in prepared
Just show up — you think better in real-time, over-preparing is wasted effort

questions.text: The team is debating Monolith vs. Microservices and it's getting heated. You tend to...
choices: Jump in early, think out loud, and sharpen your view through back-and-forth
Listen to everyone first, then deliver one well-formed take when you're ready

questions.text: Your agent spots a bug in your code. How do you want it to respond?
choices: Cut to it: file, line, root cause, fix — no preamble needed
Explain why it's a bug so I actually understand it, not just patch it

questions.text: You're designing a new service from scratch. Which agent mode is most useful?
choices: "Here are several architecture options with their trade-offs" — give me the big picture
"Here's working code for exactly what you need" — give me something that runs

questions.text: During a deep coding session, your ideal agent is...
choices: Proactive: it watches along and flags potential risks before you even ask
On standby: it waits until I ask, then gives a precise answer without breaking my flow

questions.text: You prefer your agent's output to look like...
choices: Structured: bullet points, clear headers, code blocks — scannable and copy-paste ready
Conversational: like a senior dev explaining over Slack — natural and easy to read

questions.text: You've been stuck on a weird, intermittent Production bug for 3 hours. You want your agent to...
choices: Throw unconventional hypotheses — race conditions, memory leaks, angles you haven't considered
Walk through it systematically: logs, stack trace, known failure modes, step by step

mbti_short_desc.INTJ: Strategic, analytical, and fiercely independent. Speaks in solutions.
mbti_short_desc.INTP: Precise, theoretical, and relentlessly curious. Loves the edge cases.
mbti_short_desc.ENTJ: Bold, decisive, and relentlessly efficient. Turns goals into action.
mbti_short_desc.ENTP: Innovative, provocative, and quick-witted. Challenges every assumption.
mbti_short_desc.INFJ: Insightful, principled, and quietly visionary. Sees the deeper pattern.
mbti_short_desc.INFP: Empathetic, creative, and values-driven. Code should tell a story.
mbti_short_desc.ENFJ: Inspiring, warm, and genuinely invested in your growth.
mbti_short_desc.ENFP: Enthusiastic, creative, and sees possibilities everywhere.
mbti_short_desc.ISTJ: Reliable, thorough, and methodical. Does it right, every time.
mbti_short_desc.ISFJ: Caring, detail-focused, and protective. Catches what others miss.
mbti_short_desc.ESTJ: Organized, goal-oriented, and unambiguous. Gets things done.
mbti_short_desc.ESFJ: Warm, supportive, and attentive. Makes collaboration feel easy.
mbti_short_desc.ISTP: Practical, precise, and hands-on. Minimal words, maximum results.
mbti_short_desc.ISFP: Flexible, aesthetic, and present-focused. Finds beauty in simplicity.
mbti_short_desc.ESTP: Energetic, pragmatic, and bold. Ships fast and iterates faster.
mbti_short_desc.ESFP: Spontaneous, fun, and expressive. Makes coding feel like an adventure.
